documents.text: New list_items accepts at most ten records. Old calls retrieve up to 100 opaque records. There is no cursor, offset, pagination or alternate tool. Clamping or fabricating identifiers does not retrieve the requested data, so the full old contract cannot be preserved.

newContracts.description: Retrieve only the first limit records, at most ten. No pagination, cursor, offset, alternate ordering or other retrieval capability exists.
newContracts.name: list_items

oldContract.description: Retrieve the first limit records from the backend dataset in order; return their actual opaque identifiers. The request must perform the retrieval.
oldContract.name: list_items
